# FundedLot

> FundedLot (also written "Funded Lot") is a prop-firm challenge practice app for iOS and Android.
> It is an educational trading simulator: real market prices, the exact evaluation rules
> (profit targets, daily loss limits, static and trailing drawdown, minimum trading days),
> a pre-trade risk guard, and a mistake engine that detects and prices trading errors.
> Virtual funds only. FundedLot is not a prop firm, not a broker, offers no real-money
> trading, no funded accounts, and no payouts, and is not affiliated with any prop firm.

## Product
- [How it works](https://www.fundedlot.com/how-it-works/): the practice loop — pick rules, trade, read the autopsy, retry
- [Features](https://www.fundedlot.com/features/): rules engine, risk guard, mistake detectors, readiness score
- [Pricing](https://www.fundedlot.com/pricing/): free tier, attempt packs, Pro subscription
- [Mentor](https://www.fundedlot.com/mentor/): paid room — daily setups with entry zones, a mentor who passed, verified proof wall; Circle and Mentor 1:1 plans, sold on the web and in the app
- [Download](https://www.fundedlot.com/download/): App Store and Google Play availability
- [FundedLot on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fundedlot-prop-firm-practice/id6806785387): the iPhone app
- [FundedLot on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.myindianow.fundedlot): the Android app
- [FAQ](https://www.fundedlot.com/faq/): common questions, answered plainly
